tasks.goal: Print the report on paper

frictionEvents.evidence: pathway dead-ends before the goal: No in-app print control exists anywhere on the study page (footer offers only მონახაზის შენახვა / PDF ნახვა / PDF ჩამოტვირთვა). PDF ნახვა opened a new tab (window.open blob:, application/pdf 48 KB, print() never called by the app). The only remaining route is the browser PDF viewer's own print button in that new tab, which this walker's harness cannot drive (it controls only the app tab), so no print dialog was observed. MEASUREMENT LIMIT: a human can probably print from the Chromium viewer toolbar; re-verify by hand before treating this as an app block. The app-side fact is: printing depends entirely on the browser viewer.
